headline: Bruins place James Hagens on injured reserve
take:
Boston has put James Hagens on injured reserve and called up Mike Eyssimont from Providence, Daily Faceoff reports. The reason hasn't been made public.

It's a loss the Bruins will feel. Hagens, the seventh overall pick in 2025, has 12 points (six goals) in 17 games while playing just 13:20 a night, a rate of 3.17 points per 60 that most veteran forwards would take. Our caution: his on-ice luck is running hot, with his teammates scoring well above their chances while he's out there, so some cooling was coming anyway. The bigger point is that Boston's 12-4-1 start rests on goaltending (12.6 goals saved beyond expected) more than on play, with the expected goals split close to even. Losing scoring depth makes that margin thinner.
